title: Lore Entry
description: Defines a single entry in the game's lore database with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and system synergies.

name.description: The display name of the lore entry.

lore_type.description: The type of lore entry this represents.

era.description: The primary era this lore is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

importance_level.description: The scope and importance of this lore entry.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the lore entry, its history, significance, and role in the galaxy. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote, description, or memorable phrase that captures the essence of this lore entry.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this lore entry is viewed and valued by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Layered description of the lore entry, with some information requiring discovery.

text.description: The text content of this description layer.

discovery_requirements.description: Requirements that must be met to discover this layer of information.

type.description: Type of requirement for discovering this information.

quest_id.description: Quest ID that must be completed for quest_completed type.

item_id.description: Item ID that must be found for item_found type.

relationship_level.description: Required relationship level for relationship_level type.

location_id.description: Location ID that must be visited for location_visited type.

time_required.description: Time that must elapse for time_elapsed type (e.g., '1 week', '1 month').

physical_description.description: For locations, planets, creatures, or artifacts: detailed physical description of appearance and characteristics.

historical_context.description: Layered historical context, with some information requiring discovery.

text.description: The text content of this historical context layer.

discovery_requirements.description: Requirements that must be met to discover this layer of information.

type.description: Type of requirement for discovering this information.

quest_id.description: Quest ID that must be completed for quest_completed type.

item_id.description: Item ID that must be found for item_found type.

relationship_level.description: Required relationship level for relationship_level type.

location_id.description: Location ID that must be visited for location_visited type.

time_required.description: Time that must elapse for time_elapsed type (e.g., '1 week', '1 month').

current_status.description: The current state or condition of this lore entry in the present timeline.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - lore entries, factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (lore, faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Located On', 'Native Homeworld', 'Natural Synergy', 'Historical Ally', 'Created By', 'Discovered By'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this lore entry from Star Wars canon.

famous_events.description: Notable events or moments related to this lore entry.

notable_figures.description: Important individuals associated with this lore entry.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this lore entry.

adventure_seeds.description: Potential adventure ideas that could involve this lore entry.

character_connections.description: Ways characters might be connected to or affected by this lore entry.

knowledge_checks.description: Types of knowledge checks that might reveal information about this lore entry.

cultural_impact.description: How this lore entry affects the cultures and societies of the galaxy.

political_significance.description: The political implications and significance of this lore entry.

mechanical_effects.description: Mechanical effects and benefits related to this lore entry.

knowledge_benefits.description: Benefits gained from knowing about this lore entry.

skill_modifiers.description: Skill checks that might be modified by knowledge of this lore entry.

equipment_access.description: Equipment or items that might be accessible through knowledge of this lore entry.

special_abilities.description: Special abilities that might be unlocked through this lore entry.

tags.description: Keywords for the LLM to easily categorize and find information.

themes.description: Thematic elements associated with this lore entry.

mood.description: The emotional tone or atmosphere associated with this lore entry.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this lore entry, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this lore entry adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Character_Portrait', 'Location', 'Combat_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this lore entry is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the lore entry's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the lore entry's icon for UI display.
